content_sections.heading: ICSIL Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICSIL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICSIL Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ICSIL Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 11 vacancies are available - 1 each for Assistant General Manager (HR & Admin.) (E4 grade), Deputy General Manager (Outsourcing) (E5 Grade), Deputy General Manager (Projects), Junior Accounts Officer (Finance & Accounts), Sr. Accountant (Finance & Accounts), Sr. Supervisor (Outsourcing), Sr. Supervisor (Legal), and Junior Engineer Gr. 1 (Projects), and 2 for Supervisor (Outsourcing).

content_sections.heading: ICSIL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The educational qualification required for ICSIL Recruitment 2026 varies by post. Candidates should note that MBA/MCA/LLB obtained through correspondence mode is not accepted for the relevant posts, as explicitly stated in the notification.

rows.minimum_educational_qualification: Graduation in any discipline plus MBA (HR) - MBA by correspondence not allowed
Graduation in any discipline plus MBA (HR) - MBA by correspondence not allowed
Bachelor of Engineering (Full-Time) in IT/Computer Science/Electronics & Communication/Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics/AMIE, OR MCA - MCA by correspondence not allowed
Graduate plus MBA (HR) - MBA by correspondence not allowed
Graduate plus MBA (HR) - MBA by correspondence not allowed
Graduate plus LLB (Regular) - LLB by correspondence not allowed
10th pass plus 3-year regular diploma course in IT/Projects

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ICSIL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICSIL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Intelligent Communication Systems India (ICSIL) for filling various executive and supervisory positions on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been announced across various posts including Assistant General Manager, Deputy General Manager, Junior Accounts Officer, and Engineers.

faq.question: Q3. What is the starting date to apply online for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 28 September 2026 for eligible candidates holding suitable qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the online application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for ICSIL recruitment is 19 October 2026. Candidates must apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for ICSIL various posts?
faq.answer: All candidates applying for the ICSIL recruitment are required to pay an application fee of INR 590/- as per the official notification details.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Assistant General Manager and DGM posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree in any discipline along with an MBA (HR) or relevant technical degrees depending upon the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit varies between 35 to 45 years depending on the post applied for, as specified in the official notification guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates based on document scrutiny followed by an interaction or interview conducted by ICSIL.

faq.question: Q9. How can candidates apply for ICSIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official ICSIL website at www.icsil.in and submit required documents offline as per instructions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification link for ICSIL Recruitment?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and direct application links in the Important Links section of this recruitment notification article.
